entries.title: BaseModel method renames (breaking)
entries.migration: old_method -> new_method: __fields__ -> model_fields, __private_attributes__ -> __pydantic_private__, __validators__ -> __pydantic_validator__, construct() -> model_construct(), copy() -> model_copy(), dict() -> model_dump(), json() -> model_dump_json(), json_schema() -> model_json_schema(), parse_obj() -> model_validate(), update_forward_refs() -> model_rebuild()
entries.quote: Various method names have been changed; all non-deprecated BaseModel methods now have names matching either the format model_.* or __.*pydantic.__.

entries.title: Field parameter renames (breaking)
entries.migration: Field(regex=...) -> Field(pattern=...), Field(min_items=...) -> Field(min_length=...), Field(max_items=...) -> Field(max_length=...), Field(allow_mutation=...) -> Field(frozen=...), Field(regex=...) -> Field(pattern=...), Field(final=...) -> typing.Final type hint
entries.quote: Field no longer supports arbitrary keyword arguments to be added to the JSON schema. Instead, any extra data you want to add to the JSON schema should be passed as a dictionary to the json_schema_extra keyword argument.

entries.title: validator and root_validator deprecated (breaking)
entries.migration: @validator -> @field_validator, @root_validator -> @model_validator. New decorators require ValidationInfo argument; old decorators cannot use field/config kwargs.
entries.quote: @validator has been deprecated, and should be replaced with @field_validator, which provides various new features and improvements.

entries.title: BaseSettings moved to pydantic-settings (breaking)
entries.migration: from pydantic.BaseSettings -> from pydantic_settings.BaseSettings
entries.quote: BaseSettings has moved to a separate package, pydantic-settings.

entries.title: Config class removed (breaking)
entries.migration: class Config: -> model_config = ConfigDict(...)
entries.quote: In Pydantic V2, to specify config on a model, you should set a class attribute called model_config to be a dict with the key/value pairs you want to be used as the config. The Pydantic V1 behavior to create a class called Config in the namespace of the parent BaseModel subclass is now deprecated.

entries.title: Config setting renames (breaking)
entries.migration: allow_population_by_field_name -> populate_by_name, anystr_lower -> str_to_lower, anystr_strip_whitespace -> str_strip_whitespace, anystr_upper -> str_to_upper, getter_dict -> (removed, orm_mode -> from_attributes, schema_extra -> json_schema_extra, validate_all -> validate_default
entries.quote: The following config settings have been renamed: allow_population_by_field_name → populate_by_name (or validate_by_name starting in v2.11), anystr_lower → str_to_lower, anystr_strip_whitespace → str_strip_whitespace, anystr_upper → str_to_upper, getter_dict → (removed, orm_mode → from_attributes, schema_extra → json_schema_extra, validate_all → validate_default

entries.title: Removed config settings (breaking)
entries.migration: Removed: allow_mutation, error_msg_templates, fields, getter_dict, smart_union, underscore_attrs_are_private, json_loads, json_dumps, copy_on_model_validation, post_init_call
entries.quote: The following config settings have been removed: allow_mutation, error_msg_templates, fields, getter_dict, smart_union, underscore_attrs_are_private, json_loads, json_dumps, copy_on_model_validation, post_init_call

entries.title: error_wrappers.ValidationError moved (breaking)
entries.migration: from pydantic.error_wrappers.ValidationError -> from pydantic.ValidationError
entries.quote: pydantic.error_wrappers.ValidationError -> pydantic.ValidationError

entries.title: Deprecated Field properties removed (breaking)
entries.migration: Removed: const, min_items (use min_length), max_items (use max_length), unique_items, allow_mutation (use frozen), regex (use pattern), final (use typing.Final)
entries.quote: The following properties have been removed from or changed in Field: const, min_items (use min_length), max_items (use max_length), unique_items, allow_mutation (use frozen), regex (use pattern), final (use the typing.Final type hint instead)

entries.title: GenericModel removed (breaking)
entries.migration: class MyGenericModel(BaseModel, Generic[T]) -> instead of class MyGenericModel(GenericModel)
entries.quote: The pydantic.generics.GenericModel class is no longer necessary, and has been removed. Instead, you can now create generic BaseModel subclasses by just adding Generic as a parent class on a BaseModel subclass directly.

entries.title: Dataclass behavior changes (breaking)
entries.migration: Dataclasses no longer accept tuples as validation inputs; use dicts. __post_init__ now called after validation. extra='allow' no longer stores extra fields. __pydantic_model__ attribute removed. Use TypeAdapter for validation.
entries.quote: When used as fields, dataclasses (Pydantic or vanilla) no longer accept tuples as validation inputs; dicts should be used instead.

entries.title: Constrained* types removed (breaking)
entries.migration: Replace with Annotated[, Field(...)]: MyInt = Annotated[int, Field(ge=0)]
entries.quote: The Constrained* classes were removed, and you should replace them by Annotated[, Field(...)], for example: from typing import Annotated from pydantic import BaseModel, Field MyInt = Annotated[int, Field(ge=0)] class Model(BaseModel): x: MyInt

entries.title: Removed utility functions (breaking)
entries.migration: Removed: deep_update, GetterDict, lenient_issubclass, lenient_isinstance, is_valid_field, update_not_none, import_string, Representation, ROOT_KEY, smart_deepcopy, sequence_like
entries.quote: Various utility functions moved to pydantic.v1 namespace or removed entirely.

entries.title: Removed types (breaking)
entries.migration: Use Annotated or standard types instead
entries.quote: Multiple types removed; replace with Annotated or standard Python types.

entries.title: Float->int conversion stricter (breaking)
entries.migration: float->int only allowed if decimal part is zero; otherwise ValidationError with type=int_from_float
entries.quote: In V2, type conversion from floats to integers is only allowed if the decimal part is zero

entries.title: Type conversion float->int stricter (breaking)
entries.migration: float->int conversion only allowed if decimal part is zero; otherwise ValidationError
entries.quote: In V2, type conversion from floats to integers is only allowed if the decimal part is zero

entries.title: Url/Dsn types no longer inherit from str (breaking)
entries.migration: Use str(url) to convert to string; URL validation behavior changed (slashes appended)
entries.quote: In Pydantic V1 the AnyUrl type inherited from str, and all the other Url and Dsn types inherited from these. In Pydantic V2 these types are built on two new Url and MultiHostUrl classes using Annotated.

entries.title: parse_raw/parse_file deprecated (breaking)
entries.migration: Use model_validate_json instead of parse_raw; load data then pass to model_validate
entries.quote: Some of the built-in data-loading functionality has been slated for removal. In particular, parse_raw and parse_file are now deprecated.

entries.title: from_orm deprecated (breaking)
entries.migration: Use model_validate with from_attributes=True instead
entries.quote: The from_orm method has been deprecated; you can now just use model_validate (equivalent to parse_obj from Pydantic V1) to achieve something similar, as long as you've set from_attributes=True in the model config.

entries.title: JSON schema generation changes (breaking/behavior)
entries.migration: Optional fields now indicate null allowed in schema. Decimal serialized as string. Named tuples no longer preserved as namedtuples. Schema targets draft 2020-12 by default.
entries.quote: In Pydantic V2, we have tried to address many of the common requests: The JSON schema for Optional fields now indicates that the value null is allowed.

entries.title: Union mode short-circuit change (behavior)
entries.migration: Unions now preserve input type when possible; use Field(union_mode='left_to_right') for V1-like left-to-right behavior
entries.quote: In Pydantic V2, we recognize that the value is an instance of one of the cases and short-circuit the standard union validation.

entries.title: Optional/Required field logic changed (behavior)
entries.migration: Optional/Required field behavior now matches dataclasses more closely; see migration guide table
entries.quote: Pydantic V2 changes some of the logic for specifying whether a field annotated as Optional is required or not, and now more closely matches the behavior of dataclasses.

entries.title: Regex engine changed (behavior)
entries.migration: Pydantic V2 uses Rust regex crate; drop lookarounds/backreferences. Use regex_engine config to use Python regex.
entries.quote: Pydantic V1 used Python's regex library. Pydantic V2 uses the Rust regex crate.

entries.title: GetterDict removed (breaking)
entries.migration: Removed as implementation detail of orm_mode
entries.quote: GetterDict has been removed as it was just an implementation detail of orm_mode, which has been removed.

entries.title: TypeAdapter introduced (feature)
entries.migration: New class for validating/serializing non-BaseModel types; replaces parse_obj_as and schema_of (deprecated)
entries.quote: In Pydantic V2 this is a lot easier: the TypeAdapter class lets you create an object with methods for validating, serializing, and producing JSON schemas for arbitrary types.

entries.title: Mypy plugin changes (noise)
entries.migration: Plugin path changes; enable pydantic.mypy or pydantic.v1.mypy as needed
entries.quote: Pydantic V2 contains a mypy plugin in pydantic.mypy.

payload.analysis: The upgrade to pydantic 2.14.1 introduces multiple breaking changes. The import errors show: 1) `ValidationError` moved from `pydantic.error_wrappers` to `pydantic`, 2) `BaseSettings` moved to `pydantic-settings` package. Additionally, the models file uses deprecated v1 APIs: `BaseModel` method renames (`dict()` -> `model_dump()`, `parse_obj()` -> `model_validate()`), `Field` parameter renames (`min_length`/`max_length` instead of `min_items`/`max_items`, `pattern` instead of `regex`), validator decorators (`@validator` -> `@field_validator`, `@root_validator` -> `@model_validator`), Config class -> `model_config = ConfigDict(...)`, config setting renames (`orm_mode` -> `from_attributes`, `anystr_strip_whitespace` -> `str_strip_whitespace`), removed `allow_mutation` config, `const` parameter -> `typing.Final`, `__fields__` -> `model_fields`, and `GenericModel` removal. The settings file needs `BaseSettings` import from `pydantic_settings` and Config migration.

edits.justification: Migrated all pydantic v1 APIs to v2: ValidationError import, BaseModel method renames (dict->model_dump, parse_obj->model_validate, __fields__->model_fields), Field parameter changes (const->Final, min_length/max_length), validator decorators (@validator->@field_validator, @root_validator->@model_validator), Config class->model_config=ConfigDict, config setting renames (orm_mode->from_attributes, anystr_strip_whitespace->str_strip_whitespace, allow_mutation->frozen), and removed GenericModel usage.
Migrated BaseSettings import to pydantic-settings package, replaced Config class with model_config=ConfigDict, and updated env_prefix config setting.
